verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents Payment Links and a Billing suite covering multi-item products and subscriptions. Its agent tooling can write account resources programmatically: the CLI exposes a broad slice of the API, the AgentOS MCP reads and writes production resources, the Developer MCP creates sandbox resources, and a contract-to-billing skill exists. The evidence never explicitly shows API endpoints for creating products, prices, and payment links, or an agent chaining them in one session. Missing for 10: explicit API or MCP evidence for creating product and price objects, documented programmatic payment-link creation, an end-to-end agent walkthrough of the three-step flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
